name: 29007-solodecode-dsv4flashfp8-tp8
model: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 -- public and ungated, 46 safetensors shards, ~294 GB, ~36.8 GB of weights per card at TP8.
parallelism: TP=8 on one node, PP=1. No data-parallel attention, no expert parallelism, no all-to-all dispatch backend, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 50 requests with a 1800 s safety cap -- 40 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix reuse: exactly 4096 prompt tokens in and exactly 1536 output tokens out, no variance on either, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant generating lengthy reports for one user at a time on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments. `cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` is the modern form of
# `--cuda-graph-max-bs`, which the pinned commit still accepts but warns on. The two
# context-parallel flags keep their deprecated spelling: given the modern forms instead
# (`enable-prefill-cp`, `cp-strategy`), this commit refuses to start this architecture.
model-path: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 8
enable-symm-mem: true
page-size: 64
max-running-requests: 64
cuda-graph-max-bs-decode: 64
swa-full-tokens-ratio: 0.02
enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel: true
nsa-prefill-cp-mode: round-robin-split
disable-radix-cache: true
# 0.85 rather than a higher fraction: an 80 GB card has little room outside the static budget,
# and the KV pool it leaves is far larger than a single 5632-token request needs.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
